page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.small is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c1 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 8 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The absence of hyperthreading means each of the 8 vCPUs corresponds to a dedicated physical core, ensuring compute resources are not shared across threads on the same core.

With a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:1, the ecs.c1.small is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not demand large memory footprints. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for pure CPU-bound processing where memory overhead is minimal. Suitable workloads include batch processing, CPU-focused mathematical modeling, and distributed compute nodes that rely on external storage systems.
